summary: Anthropic launched a tiered Services Track and a Partner Hub portal for its Claude Partner Network, formalizing certification and standing for consulting firms that deploy Claude, and cited large-scale enterprise rollouts (e.g., Deloitte 470,000 people, Cognizant 350,000 associates, KPMG 276,000) already underway.

mechanisms.reason: Disclosed enterprise rollouts across hundreds of thousands of professionals at major consultancies imply a large expansion in aggregate Claude usage and token volume.
mechanisms.quote: Deloitte is making it available to 470,000 people across its global network. KPMG is integrating Claude across a workforce of more than 276,000.

mechanisms.reason: Mentions of firms building Claude-powered agents and rolling out Claude Code/Cowork suggest a shift toward agentic, tool-using deployments within enterprises.
mechanisms.quote: Infosys is building Claude-powered agents for specific industries, and PwC is rolling out Claude Code and Cowork starting with its US teams

categories.reason: Anthropic's own platform and its ecosystem of certified partners deploying Claude at scale represent growth in cloud/platform-based AI consumption.
categories.quote: The largest professional-services firms in the world are building their own practices around Claude — putting it into production for clients while getting it into the hands of their own people.
